source_issue.title: PLIP: Start separating Blicca (Classic UI) code from the core

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue aims to gradually separate Classic UI code from the core Plone package, enhancing maintainability and allowing for cleaner code structures. The proposed adjustments will keep the classic UI operational by moving its templates and view logic to the `plone.app.layout` package while maintaining business logic in the core packages.

## What needs to be done
- Move Classic UI templates and related view logic to a dedicated package, likely `plone.app.layout`.
- Ensure backward compatibility and manage deprecation warnings for any moved templates.
- The goal is to improve overall application performance, especially for users utilizing the Volto frontend.

## Helpful background
This is part of an ongoing effort to refine the architecture of Plone in preparation for future versions. Discussions indicate varying opinions on the structure of these packages; clarity on where specific components reside may still be needed.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the current state of the Classic UI and the proposed `plone.app.layout` setup.
2. Review existing templates and identify those relevant to Classic UI.
3. Engage with the community to discuss approaches in moving templates and ensuring compatibility.
4. Consider contributing by working on deprecation warnings or testing transitions for affected templates.
```
